categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies SOCKS5 proxy outbound connection handling for Tor peer connections, touching network proxy transport code and peer connectivity.
categories.rationale: Fixes silent connection drops when routing outbound connections to IPv6 peers through Tor proxies. As noted in the description, roughly 20% of addrman addresses and 29% of DNS seed IPv6 answers contain inner `::` sequences that trigger an upstream Tor exit relay parser bug, causing streams to fail.
